messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#360] Installing rmr1.3.1 on EC2
parts:
Yes 2.0.1 has additional dependencies, unfortunately  I can't maintain Jeffrey's code. You need to have functional and httr installed on every node. httr will trigger a dependency on RCurl (automatically installed) which needs two non-R packages, curl and curl-devel (on centOS, names may change on other distros). Unfortunately we switched to non open source scripts for our internal testing which means we don't have a reference installation script any more, I think we need to fix that. Also we are preparing a 2.0.2 with a reduced set of dependencies, we probably went a little to far in 2.0.1. Thanks


Antonio
